persona: Product NIC driver engineer who has not yet worked upstream
resumeText:
Rohan Kulkarni | Pune | rohan.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Systems Software Engineer, Sahyadri Networks, Pune (2020 - present)
- Maintain the in-house Linux kernel network driver for our 25G Ethernet adapter on kernel 6.1.
- Wrote PCIe probe, interrupt and DMA handling code in C for the driver.
- Fixed race conditions in the transmit path using spinlocks and RCU.
- Debug kernel panics from kdump crash dumps and ftrace traces.
- Backport fixes from mainline into our product kernel tree with git.
- Wrote bash scripts to run nightly driver regression tests.

Associate Engineer, Konkan Embedded Labs, Pune (2018 - 2020)
- Wrote character device drivers for sensor boards running embedded Linux.

SKILLS
C, Linux kernel, Git, Python, Bash

EDUCATION
BTech Electronics and Telecommunication, College of Engineering Pune, 2018
